items.title: BTS becomes first pop group to surpass $500 m in tour ticket sales
items.snippet: Global K-pop sensation BTS has become the first pop group in the world to surpass $500 million in cumulative ticket sales with its ongoing "Arirang" world tour, Billboard said. The...
items.description: Global K-pop sensation BTS has become the first pop group in the world to surpass $500 million in cumulative ticket sales with its ongoing "Arirang" world tour, Billboard said. The South Korean septet's tour was the seventh by any group to reach the milestone, the US music industry publication said, citing its latest Boxscore figures released Wednesday.
